name: BSP_AiPlanner_ClaimGroup
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_ai_group_think, read-only analysis. __thiscall(planner)(group), RET 4, body 00A22750-00A227B2, read in full. Calls 00A2C600(group), then 00A1C8B0(planner)(group) and returns when that is true. name: BSP_AiGroup_SetCommand
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Body read in full (00a2bd00-00a2bd30), __thiscall(ECX = AI group)(command), RET 4. Deletes the previous command at group+564ch through its vtable slot 0 with the flag 1, then stores the new pointer; the null path stores without deleting. Passing the pointer the group already holds would free it and leave it dangling. Sole call site 00a37ade, the AISetCommand Lua binding. docs/LUA_BINDING_AI.md.

name: BSP_AiGroup_ForwardCommand
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(aiGroup /*ECX*/, void* command, const SceneCommandTarget* target). Seven instructions: reads aiGroup+564Ch (the group's current command object, docs/LUA_BINDING_AI.md kAiGroupCommandOffset) and tail-jumps to its vtable[24h] with both stack arguments, or RET 8 when it is null. Ghidra's unrecovered-jumptable warning at 00a2bd9f is that tail call. Callers 0077d600 and 0071ecf0. Complete: 00a2bd90-00a2bda3. docs/ENTITY_ORDER_MESSAGE.md | Run-time evidence, bsp_game.exe milestone 2l: not reached by any of the 13 authored Cruise commands. Both of its call sites are gated on an AI group: 0077d787 reads entity+16ch on the commanded entity and 0071ed54 reads it on the session endpoint's subject. Nothing in the reconstruction writes entity+16ch except the AICreateGroup binding 00a38a50 through 00a2dfa0 / 00a2d8e0, and a scan of the 299 installed mission scripts finds no call to AICreateGroup, AICreate, AISetCommand, AIEnableGrouping or AIMergeGroups; usn_2_java.lua calls no AI binding at all.
